# Supported formats and application profiles

*Generated by `scripts/gen_profiles_doc.py` - do not edit by hand.*

## File formats

| Kind | Name | Typical files | Extensions |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ese` | Microsoft ESE / JET Blue | ntds.dit, SRUDB.dat, Exchange .edb, WebCacheV01.dat, Windows.edb, UAL | `.edb` `.dit` `.dat` `.mdb` `.jtx` `.vol` |
| `sqlite` | SQLite 3 | iOS/Android app databases, Chrome/Firefox/Safari, macOS knowledgeC, Windows ActivitiesCache, Signal, WhatsApp | `.db` `.sqlite` `.sqlite3` `.sqlitedb` `.storedata` `.db3` `.s3db` |
| `leveldb` | LevelDB (Chromium / Electron) | Chrome/Edge IndexedDB & Local/Session Storage, Discord, Teams, Slack, VS Code | `.ldb` `.log` |
| `access` | Microsoft Access (Jet/ACE) | .mdb / .accdb application databases | `.mdb` `.accdb` |
| `dbf` | dBase / FoxPro (DBF) | Legacy business applications, GIS shapefile attribute tables | `.dbf` |
| `bsddb` | Berkeley DB | RPM databases, sendmail/postfix maps, older Firefox cert stores | `.db` `.bdb` |
| `sqldump` | SQL dump (MySQL / PostgreSQL / SQLite) | mysqldump, pg_dump and sqlite .dump text exports | `.sql` |
| `bson` | BSON dump (mongodump) | MongoDB collection dumps | `.bson` |

Files are recognised by signature, not extension. A LevelDB store is a *directory*; opening any file
inside it (`CURRENT`, `*.ldb`, `*.log`) opens the whole store.

## Application profiles

A profile is matched from the table names (and file name) of an opened database. It supplies friendly table
names, the timestamp encoding of known columns and ready-made **artifact views** (SQL) that appear under
*Analysis views* in the GUI, `edb-explorer views`, and the `list_views` / `run_view` MCP tools.

### Windows

| Profile | Formats | Identified by | Views |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Active Directory (NTDS.dit)**<br>Active Directory domain database: objects, attributes, security descriptors and links. | ese | `datatable`, `link_table`, `sd_table` | - |
| **System Resource Usage Monitor (SRUDB.dat)**<br>Windows SRUM telemetry: per-application network, CPU, energy and connectivity usage. | ese | `SruDbIdMapTable`, `SruDbCheckpointTable` | `network_usage`, `network_totals`, `app_resource_usage`, `connectivity` |
| **IE / Edge WebCache (WebCacheV01.dat)**<br>Internet Explorer / legacy Edge browsing history, cache, cookies and downloads. | ese | `Containers`, `LeakFiles` | `containers` |
| **Windows Search Index (Windows.edb)**<br>Windows Search indexer: indexed file metadata, paths and content snippets. | ese | `SystemIndex_PropertyStore`, `SystemIndex_Gthr` | - |
| **Windows Update DataStore (DataStore.edb)**<br>Windows Update history, files and update metadata. | ese | `tbFiles`, `tbUpdates` | - |
| **Windows Timeline (ActivitiesCache.db)**<br>Windows 10 Timeline: applications used, documents opened, clipboard, per-session focus. Unix seconds. | sqlite | `Activity`, `ActivityOperation`, `Activity_PackageId` | `activities`, `apps` |
| **Windows Notifications (wpndatabase.db)**<br>Toast/tile notifications received by the user. FILETIME timestamps. | sqlite | `Notification`, `NotificationHandler` | `notifications` |

### macOS

| Profile | Formats | Identified by | Views |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Safari History.db**<br>Safari browsing history (macOS / iOS). Timestamps are Cocoa seconds since 2001. | sqlite | `history_items`, `history_visits` | `history` |
| **knowledgeC.db (CoreDuet)**<br>macOS/iOS app usage, screen state, Bluetooth, media playback, Safari and more (streams in ZSTREAMNAME). | sqlite | `ZOBJECT`, `ZSTRUCTUREDMETADATA` | `streams`, `app_usage`, `all_events` |
| **macOS Quarantine events**<br>Downloaded files recorded by Gatekeeper (LaunchServices QuarantineEventsV2). | sqlite | `LSQuarantineEvent` | `downloads` |
| **macOS TCC.db**<br>Privacy permissions granted to applications (camera, microphone, full disk access ...). | sqlite | `access`, `policies` | `permissions` |
| **macOS Notification Center db**<br>Delivered notifications per app. | sqlite | `record`, `app` | `notifications` |

### iOS

| Profile | Formats | Identified by | Views |
|---|---|---|---|
| **iOS / macOS Messages (sms.db / chat.db)**<br>iMessage and SMS conversations. Dates are Cocoa nanoseconds (seconds on older iOS). | sqlite | `message`, `handle`, `chat` | `messages`, `attachments`, `contacts_activity` |
| **iOS AddressBook.sqlitedb**<br>Contacts with phone numbers and e-mail addresses. | sqlite | `ABPerson`, `ABMultiValue` | `contacts` |
| **iOS CallHistory.storedata**<br>Phone / FaceTime call log. | sqlite | `ZCALLRECORD` | `calls` |
| **Apple Photos.sqlite**<br>Photo library metadata (assets, albums, locations). | sqlite | `ZASSET`, `ZGENERICASSET` | `assets` |
| **iOS backup Manifest.db**<br>File list of an iTunes/Finder backup (fileID -> domain/relativePath). | sqlite | `Files`, `Properties` | `files`, `apps` |
| **WhatsApp ChatStorage.sqlite (iOS)**<br>WhatsApp messages, chats and media on iOS. | sqlite | `ZWAMESSAGE`, `ZWACHATSESSION` | `messages` |
| **Apple Notes NoteStore.sqlite**<br>Notes app (bodies are gzip-compressed protobuf in ZICNOTEDATA). | sqlite | `ZICCLOUDSYNCINGOBJECT`, `ZICNOTEDATA` | `notes` |
| **Apple Calendar.sqlitedb**<br>Calendar events and participants. | sqlite | `CalendarItem`, `Calendar` | `events` |
| **iOS DataUsage.sqlite**<br>Per-process cellular/Wi-Fi data usage. | sqlite | `ZLIVEUSAGE`, `ZPROCESS` | `usage` |
| **interactionC.db (CoreDuet interactions)**<br>Contacts the user interacted with per app (calls, messages, mail). | sqlite | `ZINTERACTIONS`, `ZCONTACTS` | `interactions` |

### Android

| Profile | Formats | Identified by | Views |
|---|---|---|---|
| **WhatsApp msgstore.db (Android)**<br>WhatsApp messages on Android (legacy 'messages' table or newer 'message' schema). | sqlite | `messages`, `chat_list`, `message`, `chat`, `jid` | `messages_legacy`, `messages_new` |
| **Android contacts2.db**<br>Contacts, raw contacts and (on older versions) the call log. | sqlite | `raw_contacts`, `data`, `contacts` | `contacts`, `calls` |
| **Android calllog.db**<br>Call log (type 1 incoming, 2 outgoing, 3 missed, 5 rejected). | sqlite | `calls` | `calls` |
| **Android mmssms.db**<br>SMS and MMS messages (sms.type 1 inbox, 2 sent). MMS pdu.date is Unix seconds. | sqlite | `sms`, `pdu`, `threads` | `sms`, `mms` |
| **Android downloads.db**<br>DownloadManager records. | sqlite | `downloads` | `downloads` |
| **Android media store (external.db)**<br>Media scanner index of files on external storage. | sqlite | `files` | `files` |
| **Android accounts.db**<br>Accounts registered on the device. | sqlite | `accounts`, `authtokens` | `accounts` |
| **Telegram cache4.db (Android)**<br>Telegram message cache (message bodies are TL-serialised blobs). | sqlite | `messages`, `users`, `dialogs` | `messages` |

### Browsers

| Profile | Formats | Identified by | Views |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Chromium History (Chrome / Edge / Brave / Opera)**<br>Browsing history, visits, downloads and search terms. Timestamps are WebKit microseconds since 1601. | sqlite | `urls`, `visits`, `downloads` | `history`, `downloads`, `searches`, `top_sites` |
| **Chromium Cookies**<br>Cookie store (values are encrypted with the OS keychain/DPAPI). | sqlite | `cookies` | `cookies` |
| **Chromium Login Data**<br>Saved credentials (passwords encrypted) and usage times. | sqlite | `logins` | `logins` |
| **Chromium Web Data**<br>Autofill entries, addresses and payment cards. | sqlite | `autofill`, `credit_cards` | `autofill` |
| **Firefox places.sqlite**<br>Firefox history, bookmarks and downloads. Timestamps are PRTime (Unix microseconds). | sqlite | `moz_places`, `moz_historyvisits`, `moz_bookmarks` | `history`, `bookmarks`, `downloads` |
| **Firefox cookies.sqlite**<br>Firefox cookie store. | sqlite | `moz_cookies` | `cookies` |
| **Firefox formhistory.sqlite**<br>Values typed into web forms. | sqlite | `moz_formhistory` | `forms` |
| **Chromium Local Storage (LevelDB)**<br>window.localStorage of every origin: keys are '_origin\x00\x01name', values UTF-16/Latin-1. | leveldb | `live` | `storage`, `history` |
| **Chromium IndexedDB (LevelDB)**<br>IndexedDB store of a web app / Electron app (Teams, Slack, Discord, WhatsApp Web ...). Values are V8-serialised objects. | leveldb | `live` | `records` |
| **Mozilla cert8.db / key3.db**<br>Legacy NSS certificate / key store (Berkeley DB). | bsddb | `records` | - |

## Timestamp encodings

| Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `filetime` | Windows FILETIME (100ns since 1601) |
| `ole` | OLE Automation date (days since 1899-12-30) |
| `ese` | ESE DateTime (OLE or FILETIME) |
| `unix` | Unix seconds |
| `unix_ms` | Unix milliseconds |
| `unix_us` | Unix microseconds (PRTime) |
| `unix_ns` | Unix nanoseconds |
| `webkit` | WebKit/Chrome microseconds since 1601 |
| `cocoa` | Cocoa seconds since 2001 |
| `cocoa_ns` | Cocoa nanoseconds since 2001 |
| `mac_hfs` | HFS+ seconds since 1904 |

Columns not covered by a profile are still detected heuristically (`detect_timestamps`, column statistics,
timeline) from their value ranges and names.
